entries.definition: The technical-literature process by which a generative model trained iteratively on its own (or its predecessors') outputs suffers a measurable degeneration of its output distribution — narrowed tail coverage, amplified mode bias — across successive training generations.
entries.scope_note: Local operationalization for this profile only; not a claim about every use of the phrase in the wider literature.

entries.definition: A work 'instantiates' the mechanism when its own production pipeline demonstrably trains on model-generated outputs across at least two generations; a work merely 'references' the mechanism when it only discusses, depicts, or alludes to it without demonstrable recursive training.
